metaTitle: Sliding Glass Door Repair West Palm Beach | Historic Homes
description: Sliding glass door repair in West Palm Beach historic districts: which door work needs a certificate of appropriateness, and the permit rules.
h1: Sliding glass door repair in West Palm Beach
subline: In the city's 18 historic districts, repairing rollers and locks needs no historic approval, but changing the door's material, style or opening does.
answer: Sliding glass door repair in West Palm Beach, such as new rollers, a cleaned track or a lock fix, doesn't change a house's exterior, so it needs no certificate of appropriateness. A new door in a historic district does, reviewed by city staff or the Historic Preservation Board, plus a building permit rated for local wind loads.
faqHeading: Older homes and historic districts in West Palm Beach
closing: Send us a photo of the door from outside and close-ups of both bottom corners of the moving panel. We'll tell you whether it looks like a repair or a job that needs the city's sign-off.

faqs.q: Do I need a certificate of appropriateness to replace a sliding door in a West Palm Beach historic district?
faqs.a: Yes, when the new door changes the exterior. The city's 2023 application lists a change in door material or style as a staff-level review. A new or resized opening on the main facade goes to the Historic Preservation Board, while one on a side or rear facade stays with staff.

faqs.q: Does fixing rollers on a historic house in West Palm Beach need historic review?
faqs.a: Not as a rule. The city's certificate of appropriateness covers work that changes a building's exterior appearance, and new rollers or a lock inside the frame don't. If the repair turns into a new door or a different visible handle style, check with the city's historic staff first.

faqs.q: Can I put a vinyl sliding door on a historic home in West Palm Beach?
faqs.a: Ask the city before you buy one. Its guidance says vinyl is generally not permitted for windows on historic properties and points to aluminum impact products for in-kind replacement. It doesn't spell out sliding doors, so historic staff decides.

faqs.q: Which West Palm Beach neighborhoods are historic districts?
faqs.a: The city has 18 locally designated districts. Its historic district map names areas such as Old Northwood, Northwood Hills, El Cid, Flamingo Park, Grandview Heights, Prospect/Southland Park and Mango Promenade. The city's Historic Property Search map shows whether a specific house is designated.

faqs.q: What does West Palm Beach check on a replacement sliding door?
faqs.a: Wind loads and product approval. The city's Building Division says replacing a door needs a permit, the product must meet the wind loads in West Palm Beach, and it must be installed according to the manufacturer's product approval documents. Palm Beach County is outside the HVHZ, so no HVHZ approval is needed.
